entries.desc: DEV 阶段调用被挡但已知 supported 命令时，phase gate 输出 lifecycle、allowed phases、reason 和通用下一步。

evidence.note: Manual transcript shows blocked supported command now includes Lifecycle: supported, Requested phase, Allowed phases, Reason, Current phaseTools allow, and Policy source.

entries.desc: 项目级 phaseTools override 仍按原语义决定 allow/block，policy 只增强拒绝说明，不绕过自定义白名单。

evidence.note: flow-stability-smoke asserts custom phaseTools override still blocks finding_add and reports policy context without bypassing isCommandAllowed semantics.

entries.desc: 未知或没有 policy 的命令不会被错误放行，验证/报错会指向缺失 policy 而不是静默退化。

evidence.note: process-fact contract requires every MAIN_TOOLS command to have a lifecycle policy entry; missing policy fails statically rather than silently degrading.

entries.desc: DEV 阶段误跑 test_auto 时，phase gate 不只列可用命令，还显示 legacy 状态、destructive risk 和 validate/verificationEvidence 替代路径。

evidence.note: Manual transcript shows legacy test_auto blocked in DEV with Replacement: koala validate --story=<storyId>, verificationEvidence guidance, and Destructive risk: workspace-destructive.

entries.desc: test_story/test_add 这类 L4 test evidence 旧入口被挡时，提示其 gateEvidence 语义和当前流程 replacement，而不是建议盲目放开。

evidence.note: contract requires legacy L4 test_story/test_add policy to include replacement guidance instead of recommending phaseTools opening.

entries.desc: test_auto 的 confirm/destructive guard 不因新增 policy 被削弱，真实执行仍需要 confirm，koala 自身项目仍拒绝全量自测递归污染。

evidence.command: npm run build && node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs && npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke
evidence.note: test_auto handler now requires confirm:true for real execution after dryRun path; build and smoke tests pass with the destructive guard intact.

entries.desc: process-fact contract 通过，证明所有 CLI 命令都有 lifecycle policy，L4 命令有生产阶段或 replacement，legacy test/fixture 命令有 replacement/destructive guard。

evidence.note: contract verifies policy coverage for all 84 MAIN_TOOLS commands, legacy test/fixture replacement/destructive guidance, and active doc lifecycle terminology.

entries.desc: flow-stability smoke 通过，证明 finding family 仍完整、legacy test/fixture 仍被挡并带提示、phaseTools override 不被 policy 破坏。

evidence.note: flow-stability-smoke verifies finding family completeness, blocked command policy hints, legacy test_auto guidance, and phaseTools override behavior.

entries.desc: 构造缺 policy 或 L4 无生产阶段的静态检查场景时，验证会失败并点名具体命令，防止发布前漂移。

evidence.note: static parser checks duplicate/missing policy entries, missing reason/destructiveRisk, legacy guidance drift, and doc mentions lacking legacy/compat/maintenance context.
